submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at a threshold of 30 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.795% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. Through systematic simulation testing across all three candidate algorithms and multiple threshold values in the allowed range (20-60 GeV), Algorithm-L2 consistently outperforms Algorithm-L1 (best: 84.717% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (best: 74.094% at 35 GeV). The optimal threshold of 30 GeV represents the peak efficiency for Algorithm-L2, confirmed by testing neighboring threshold values. This configuration maximizes signal efficiency while meeting all constraints, including staying within the allocated rate budget and the 20-60 GeV threshold range. All three candidate algorithms were pre-vetted to fit within FPGA resource budgets (LUTs, DSPs) and optical link bandwidth requirements as stated in the project documents.
